info.title: OMNIS · DOS Limited API
info.description:
Modular monolith ERP backend for DOS Limited.

**Conventions**
- Base path: `/api/v1`
- Money fields are integers in minor units (pesewas). Field names end in `Minor`.
- Business dates are `YYYY-MM-DD`.
- Resource IDs are UUIDs unless a human-readable business number is used.
- Every state-changing request requires an `Idempotency-Key` header.
- Company context is injected from the authenticated user; clients do not send `companyId`.
- Canonical error shape: `{ "error": "<code>", "message": "<human>", "fields": {…}, "requestId": "<uuid>" }`.

Source of truth for behaviour is the frontend review build and the locked architecture documents (Steps 1–13). This document describes the implemented HTTP contract.

DevUser.description: Development only: email of the user to impersonate

IdempotencyKey.name: Idempotency-Key
IdempotencyKey.description: Client-generated unique key for this command. Prefer a UUID created when the form opens. Same key + same body replays the original response with `Idempotent-Replay: true`. Same key + different body returns 409 idempotency_mismatch.

RowVersion.name: If-Match
RowVersion.description: Optional optimistic concurrency token (rowVersion). Mismatch returns 409 stale_revision.

Forbidden.description: Authenticated but not permitted (permission, SoD, or portal isolation)

NotFound.description: Resource not found in this company

Conflict.description: Business conflict (period locked, stale revision, SoD, insufficient stock, unbalanced journal, idempotency mismatch, etc.)

error.description: Machine-readable code (e.g. period_locked, validation_failed, stale_revision, sod_violation, insufficient_stock)
